data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 48.3m (2013: GBP 15.0m) is an improvement of GBP 9.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the favourable settlement of specific Consumer Products claims on 2010 & prior years of account and favourable run-off of Property reserves on all years of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Favourable settlement of Consumer Products claims
prior_year_events.impact_description: Improvement of claims reserves established at the prior year end due to favourable settlement of specific Consumer Products claims.
Favourable run-off of Property reserves on all years of account contributed to improvement in prior year reserves.

named_events.loss_description: Significant Catastrophe losses arising from earthquakes in Chile were incurred.
Significant Catastrophe losses arising from earthquakes in New Zealand were incurred.
Poor performance in the Property account arising from exposure to the Japanese earthquake.
Exposure to the Thailand floods contributed to adverse Property performance.
Exposure to Hurricane Irene contributed to adverse Property performance.
Exposure to US tornadoes contributed to adverse Property performance.
Claims related to Superstorm Sandy affected the year (mentioned as an exception to otherwise benign experience).

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 70.746m. The syndicate reports a net improvement (release) in prior-year reserves of GBP 9.4m driven principally by favourable settlements of specific Consumer Products claims (notably 2010 & prior years) and favourable run-off in Property reserves across years. This prior year improvement is presented as a net figure (after reinsurance) in the claims note; no gross prior-year movement number is disclosed separately.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 48.3m (2013: GBP 15.0m) is an improvement of GBP 9.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the favourable settlement of specific Consumer Products claims on 2010 & prior years of account and favourable run-off of Property reserves on all years of account.
Significant Catastrophe losses arising from earthquakes in Chile and New Zealand were incurred.

The ultimate loss for the 2011 year of account has primarily been driven by poor performance in the Property account arising from exposure to the Japanese earthquake, Thailand floods, Hurricane Irene, US tornadoes and Superstorm Sandy.
an increase in attritional losses on a number of Consumer Products schemes written by the Syndicate.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (PYD) is not provided explicitly in the notes; the report states a NET improvement of GBP 9.4m to prior year claims reserves (this is after reinsurance). No gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year-only movement figure was disclosed separately in the available notes, so the net figure has been used as the PYD (flagged accordingly). Opening reserves are taken from the prior year comparative 'Claims outstanding' on the balance sheet. No gross claims development triangle was found in the report to cross-check gross PYD.
